business.headline: Higher sugar prices could hit festive season as cookies, mithai prices may soarRising sugar prices are pushing food companies to consider higher prices and smaller packs before the festive season. The supply squeeze may keep mithai, biscuit and cookie costs under pressure for consumers.

Pixxel raises $100 million in India's biggest space-tech funding roundGoogle-backed Pixxel has raised $100 million in a Series C round led by Temasek and Seraphim. Existing investors Radical Ventures and growX Ventures also participated. New investors 360 ONE Asset and IMM Investment joined the round.

CBI files case against Subhash Chandra for inflating net worth to secure loansThe CBI case centres on certificates submitted in 2018 to obtain two credit facilities totalling Rs 980 crore. One certificate placed Chandra's net worth at Rs 59,113 crore. However, during subsequent insolvency proceedings, he reportedly stated that his net worth in 2024 was just Rs 31.79 crore.

GDP dust settles, but trust emerges as the real fault lineIndia's 7.8% GDP growth has triggered a debate over data credibility, methodology and revisions. While Arvind Subramanian flagged a trust deficit and sought greater transparency, KV Subramanian defended the figures and dismissed the alternative 2.6% growth estimate as "absolutely bogus."

We never negotiate with a deadline: Piyush Goyal on India-US trade dealHis remarks come amid continuing uncertainty over US tariffs and the timeline for finalising the first tranche of the India-US trade agreement.

NCLT freezes Byju's parent company assets sold in disputed auctionThe NCLT has frozen Byju's parent TLPL's disputed asset sale and ordered the inventory preserved. The order shifts focus to ownership, valuation and the RP's authority ahead of the next hearing.

GDP growth of 7.8% or 2.5%? Surjit Bhalla, Montek Singh Ahluwalia settle debateIndia's GDP numbers might be looking strong, but the bigger picture is complicated. Economists Surjit Bhalla, Montek Singh Ahluwalia and Neelkanth Mishra broadly agree there is no evidence of data manipulation. Here's how they have discounted the argument of former Finance Secretary SC Garg.
Volkswagen to cut 12% of India workforce in cost overhaulThe move is aimed at reducing costs ahead of the company's next investment cycle in India.
Sebi begins hearings in Hindenburg-linked short-selling caseSebi has begun hearings in a case involving trades linked to Hindenburg Research's report, Reuters reported.

From chasing high yields to low liquidity: 5 bond mistakes investors should avoidExperts have outlined five common mistakes retail investors make while buying bonds. The advice underlines that fixed returns still carry credit, interest-rate and liquidity risks.

Beyond Mumbai and Delhi: The four Indias reshaping the urban economyFrom Mumbai to Chandigarh, India's urban story is no longer just about metros. Four distinct city tiers are emerging, each with its own income, spending and growth story.

Joining the GDP debate? Here's your cheat sheet to deflators, GVA and moreSubhash Chandra Garg questioned whether 7.8% tells the full story. The government pushed back, economists weighed in and the GDP jargon went into overdrive. In this article, we explain what it all actually means.

EPFO offers big relief on old EPF penalties: By when can you settle?The government has launched VISHWAS 2026, a one-time settlement scheme that allows eligible establishments to resolve long-pending disputes by paying a sharply reduced penalty.

Wai Wai's bhujia made from noodles lying on factory floor, FSSAI cracks downThe findings came after a raid at a CG Foods India factory in Rajasthan. The company is part of CG Corp Global, the conglomerate led by Binod Chaudhary, Nepal's only billionaire who is widely known as the 'Noodle King' for building the Wai Wai instant-noodle brand.

Sensex opens over 500 points higher, Nifty above 23,900; TCS, Infosys gain 2%On the BSE, Bajaj Finserv was the biggest gainer among major stocks, rising 1.68%, followed by TCS at 1.64% and Tech Mahindra at 1.57%. IndiGo, Reliance Industries, HDFC Bank and Trent were among the other notable gainers.

Volkswagen to cut 50,000 jobs, slash vehicle line-up in biggest ever overhaulVolkswagen's supervisory board has approved a transformation plan that could cut another 50,000 jobs worldwide. The move marks the group's most extensive restructuring as it faces tariffs, overcapacity and competition from Asian rivals.

Amid GDP row, BJP MP's 2018 letter to PM Modi criticising Subhash Garg resurfacesAn old 2018 letter by BJP MP Nishikant Dubey to Prime Minister Narendra Modi criticising Subhash Chandra Garg has resurfaced after Garg questioned the latest GDP figures. The episode has revived Dubey's earlier objections to Garg's fiscal approach and brought their policy clash back into focus.

Absolutely no politics: Economist Surjit Bhalla rejects GDP data fudged claimsIndia's revised GDP numbers have triggered questions over repeated revisions and the 7.8% growth rate. Surjit Bhalla explains why consumption, investment and imports offer a different picture of the data.

Small-city home boom: Why Tier 2 and Tier 3 towns are taking offFrom rising incomes to easier digital lending, several factors are putting smaller cities at the centre of India's housing story. Is the country's next home-loan boom already taking shape beyond the metros?

Are we slaves to others? Kenya's President orders Tata Chemicals to shut operationsWilliam Ruto has ordered Tata Chemicals to halt operations at Lake Magadi, accusing the company of failing to deliver enough investment, jobs and industrial development to the region despite operating there for more than a century.

entertainment.headline: Rob Reiner wins posthumous Emmy for The Bear nearly 50 years after last win Rob Reiner received a posthumous Emmy for his guest role as Albert in The Bear. The award returned him to Emmy recognition nearly 50 years after his last win and followed the show's tribute in its finale.

Hanuman Ansh box office Day 31: Rs 22-crore haul sets new theatrical high Hanuman Ansh earned an estimated Rs 22.75 crore nett on Day 31, its highest single-day collection since release. The late fifth-week surge has pushed the film's India nett total to Rs 122.13 crore.

Mirzapur The Movie box office Day 3: Bhaukaal hits as film nears Rs 140 crore globlly Mirzapur: The Movie has posed a strong opening weekend, helped by a sharp Sunday rise at the box office. The film is inching closer ton Rs 140 crore globally.

Gladiators: Ajith Kumar's documentary trailer turns theatres into cheering arenas The trailer of Gladiators: In Pursuit of Challenges was unveiled in theatres, drawing loud cheers from Ajith Kumar fans. The documentary frames his return to racing through family reflections, team voices and his own passion for the sport.

You don't have a girl: Ameesha Patel slams troll over Hardik Pandya dating rumours Actor Ameesha Patel has hit back at an X user who gave a romantic spin to her interaction with cricketer Hardik Pandya at a gathering in Mumbai.

It's divine: Varun Dhawan recommends Hanuman Ansh after watching with mother Actor Varun Dhawan posed an unsolicited video praising Hanuman Ansh after watching it in theatres with his mother. His endorsement comes as the Vishal Chaturvedi-directed film nears Rs 100 crore in 30 days.

Bigg Boss 20: Mahhi Vij's bossy streak riles up housemates, leaves Arishfa miffed The Bigg Boss 20 preview shows Mahhi Vij clashing with housemates over chores and chai. The early spats leave Aman Gandhi, Isha Rikhi and Arishfa Khan visibly irritated, setting up Day 0 drama.

Never discussing separation with Jay Bhanushali: Mahhi Vij on entering Bigg Boss 20 Mahhi Vij entered Bigg Boss 20 with no elaborate game plan, but one clear goal: winning the trophy. In an exclusive chat with India Today, the actor opens up about leaving daughter Tara behind, why she refuses to discuss her separation from Jay Bhanushali, and her equation with host Salman Khan.

Don't want to be known by someone else's name: Isha Rikhi on entering Bigg Boss 20 Actor Isha Rikhi has entered Bigg Boss 20 as one of the contestants. The decision came days after confirming her separation from rapper Badshah and ending their marriage of five months. In an interview with India Today, she said that the show is her chance to be known as herself and not through someone else's name.

Bigg Boss 20 Highlights: 15 contestants enter; Mahhi Vij becomes villain of the house Bigg Boss 20 Grand Premiere Highlights: The wait was finally over as the Bigg Boss house came alive with 15 new contestants, fresh drama and plenty of chaos. Salman Khan returned to host the season, while the contestants made their grand entries and set the tone for what promises to be an eventful season.

Samantha looks back on 5 years with Isha Foundation, shares a little life wisdom Sunday came with a little soul-searching for actor Samantha Ruth Prabhu. She spent the day at Isha Foundation, sharing glimpses from her visit along with a note about five years of learning, unlearning and becoming.

Samay Raina picks Medha Shankr as his best friend amid dating buzz Asked to pick his closest friend on the India's Got Latent 2 panel, Samay Raina went straight for Medha Shankr. His "sabse achhi dost" comment has predictably sent their dating rumours into another spin.

Bigg Boss Tamil, Telugu, Kannada Highlights: Another season of drama, twists begin Bigg Boss Tamil and Telugu 10 Grand Premiere highlights: Actors Vijay Sethupathi and Nagarjuna are all set to introduce new contestants for the 10th season of Bigg Boss Tamil and Telugu, respectively. Both versions will also see commoners sharing the house with celebrities.

Who is Rhiti Tiwari, singer-songwriter and Manoj Tiwari's daughter entering BB 20 Rhiti Tiwari has joined Bigg Boss 20, arriving on the premiere with her father Manoj Tiwari. The appearance pushes her into a wider public spotlight after music releases, business ventures and her BJP entry.

Jasmine Bhasin clears air on Aly Goni breakup rumours after viral tattoo post Actor Jasmine Bhasin denied that her viral tattoo post hinted at trouble with Aly Goni. She called out those who twisted a personal reflection into relationship speculation. She later deleted the post.

Bigg Boss 20 grand premiere: When and where to watch Salman Khan-hosted show Bigg Boss 20 premieres on JioHotstar tonight with Salman Khan introducing the contestants. The OTT-first launch, 'Vardaan' theme and mystery around Room No. 20 set up the season's central intrigue.

Who is Isha Rikhi, Punjabi actor and Badshah's estranged wife set to enter BB 20? Actor Isha Rikhi is set to enter Bigg Boss 20 shortly after Badshah confirmed their separation. The timing has brought renewed attention to her personal life and acting career.

Emraan Hashmi sparks nostalgia fest in Hyderabad as he takes over DJ console: Watch Actor Emraan Hashmi joined DJ Ganesh at Quake Arena in Hyderabad for The Emraan Era. As the actor revisited some of his most-loved film songs, the night turned into a nostalgia-fuelled celebration of his enduring music legacy.

Hanuman Ansh box office Day 30: Film surges, falls short of Rs 100 crore by lakhs Hanuman Ansh posed a sharp jump on Day 30 and moved close to Rs 100 crore nett in India. The sustained rise, driven by word of mouth, has kept the film strong in its fourth week.

general news.headline: Trapped student's SOS video call shows him under collapsed Delhi PG hostelA student trapped under the rubble of the collapsed PG hostel in south Delhi's Satya Niketan recorded an 11-second SOS video call, seeking help. The clip, shared by NSUI, captures the aftermath of the tragedy, which has killed six people so far.

Delhi PG hostel collapse toll rises to 6, new CCTV shows shopkeeper's narrow escape  Live updatesThe death toll in the PG hostel collapse in south Delhi's Satya Niketan has risen to six, while rescuers continue searching the site. A new CCTV footage from across the road has emerged, showing a shopkeeper sprinting away moments before the building came down.

India-France ties reach new heights, says PM Modi at Paris temple inaugurationSpeaking virtually at the inauguration of the Swaminarayan temple in Paris, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said India and France are building a special global strategic partnership. He said the BAPS temple would strengthen cultural ties, reflect shared craftsmanship and serve as a centre for service.

Gyirong post wiped out: Nepal flood jolts China-Nepal BRI rail planThe flash flood near the Nepal-China (Tibet) border has wrecked the Himalayan nation's key road link to Tibet, highlighting the risks facing Beijing's proposed Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) railway between Tibet and Kathmandu. Experts have called for a rethink of the design and disaster safeguards before the railway project moves beyond paper.

In UP's Jaatland, will G for ganna, J for Jaat trap Akhilesh and SP in pollsFrom SP chief Akhilesh Yadav's "chavanni to rupaiyya" remark to RLD chief Jayant Chaudhary's "G for ganna, J for Jat" retort, former allies are battling for political space in UP's western Jatland ahead of the 2027 Assembly election. In the mix are sugarcane policies, agrarian discontent, and the strength of the NDA and INDIA coalitions.

On day of Delhi PG tragedy, a demolition notice for building next doorA demolition notice for a neighbouring Satya Niketan building surfaced on the day the PG accommodation collapsed, killing six people. The unanswered question over when it was issued has sharpened scrutiny of municipal oversight, illegal construction and student housing safety.

Five killed as Amazon cargo jet overruns Miami runway, catches fireAt least five people were killed after an Amazon Prime Air cargo plane operated by 21 Air crashed while landing at Miami International Airport. Amazon said it was supporting those affected, while the FAA will investigate the incident.

Rahul Gandhi can claim PM post if Opposition wins, says CPIM's MA BabyCPIM general secretary MA Baby said Rahul Gandhi, as Leader of Opposition, can stake a claim to the Prime Minister's post if the opposition wins. He said the decision should come only after the election, while ruling out pre-poll speculation over leadership.

German designer creates shirt that makes humans invisible to AI & CCTVsGerman designer Simon Weckert has created a Digital Camouflage shirt that tricks AI cameras with colours and patterns, making it harder for them to recognise the person wearing it.

Old Monk isn't a rum. My whole life was a lieThe FSSAI has said in the Bombay High Court that Old Monk can't be sold as rum. The food regulator's action has revealed how most rums sold in India aren't rum. Most mass-market IMFL whiskies aren't whisky either. Nor are they rum. Here's addressing the elephant in the tavern.

Bye bye, Papa: Woman's last words before jumping into Chenab river to end her lifeA woman in Doda jumped into the Chenab river after speaking to her father and people on a bridge. Police, SDRF teams and local residents are searching the river as she remains untraced.

Isro will not be privatised: Space agency clarifies on private sector pushIsro has said the government's push for greater private participation in space is not a move to privatise the agency. It said the shift is meant to let industry scale mature systems while Isro focuses on frontier missions.

A week inside IIT Madras: Living among flying taxis, rockets and brain mapsFlying taxis, homegrown rockets, a human brain mapped cell by cell and a cancer vaccine for Indian bodies. After a week living inside IIT Madras, a forest campus full of deer, we ask whether this is a glimpse of the university of the future.

Live: CM Rekha Gupta arrives at Satya Niketan to take stock of rescue opsDelhi Building Collapse Live Updates: Six people were killed after a multi-storey building housing a student PG accommodation collapsed in Delhi's Satya Niketan on Sunday afternoon. At least five people were rescued, while several others, including students, were feared trapped as a major rescue operation continued.

Ukraine eyes taxing porn industry to raise $25 million for war against RussiaUkraine is weighing a bill to legalise and tax pornography as it seeks more war funds. Supporters say regulation could raise revenue, reduce corruption and ease pressure on police.

22 years on, promises unmet: UP martyr's mother offers to return Shaurya ChakraThe martyr's mother alleges that repeated delays, domicile demands and years of official apathy have left the promised land and other benefits unresolved.

McDonald's India X account posts intern's unpaid salary claim, deletes it laterA post on McDonald's India's official X handle claimed that an intern had not been paid for months. The message was later deleted.

You don't have a girl: Ameesha Patel slams troll over Hardik Pandya dating rumoursActor Ameesha Patel has hit back at an X user who gave a romantic spin to her interaction with cricketer Hardik Pandya at a gathering in Mumbai.

MCD orders sealing of illegal buildings above four floors after Satya Niketan PG collapseThe MCD has ordered the immediate sealing of illegal buildings above four floors after the Satya Niketan PG collapse. The move came as the death toll reached six, an FIR was filed, and ABVP protesters raised student safety concerns.

Indonesia volcano erupts again; 8 airports shut, over 170,000 passengers strandedVolcanic ash from Anak Krakatau shut Jakarta's main airport and seven others, disrupting travel for about 170,000 passengers. The eruption also pushed schools to go online and prompted fresh safety restrictions.

Uncle fulfils niece's wish as rare falcon fetches Rs 3.85 crore at Abu Dhabi auctionA pure-white falcon was sold for Rs 3.8 crore at an auction in Abu Dhabi to Shaikha Al Mansoori who visited the event with her uncle.

Delhi PG was 40–50 years old, basement repairs underway when it collapsed: CopsThe PG building that collapsed in Delhi's Satya Niketan during basement repair work was 40 to 50-years old. Rescue teams are searching the rubble as concerns grow over ageing PG buildings in the area.

Iran plans Hormuz exclusion zone after US strikes three oil tankersIran said it will declare an exclusion zone outside the Strait of Hormuz for selected vessels. The move sharpens its standoff with the US over shipping, oil flows and failed diplomacy.

Hajj-bound passenger forgets Rs 3 lakh on Telangana bus, conductor returns cashA Telangana State Road Transport Corporation conductor and driver returned Rs 3 lakh that a passenger left on a bus in Hyderabad. Their prompt action and verification drew praise for honesty and responsibility.

sports.headline: Duleep Trophy Day 2 Live: Desperate South hunt wicket of Ishan Kishan Duleep Trophy Final Live Day 2, East Zone vs South Zone: Ishan Kishan and Kumar Kushagra will begin Day 2 for East Zone in Chennai. A desperate South Zone will look to dust themselves and pick up their performance on the second day of the final.

How Samay Raina provoked Anand Mahindra into starting Global Chess League Anand Mahindra said a 2020 challenge from Samay Raina set the Global Chess League in motion. His remarks underscored how the league's growth rests on the human drama that keeps chess compelling.

Ben Shelton ends Tsitsipas' resurgent US Open run, sets up Alcaraz showdown Ben Shelton ended Stefanos Tsitsipas' impressive US Open revival with a dominant straight-sets win to reach the quarter-finals. The American now faces defending champion Carlos Alcaraz, with a place in the semi-finals and a bigger piece of history at stake.

Carlos Alcaraz crushes Tommy Paul, Linda Noskova storms into maiden quarters Carlos Alcaraz stormed into the US Open 2026 quarterfinals with a straight-sets win over Tommy Paul, extending his impressive run in New York. Wimbledon champion Linda Noskova also reached the last eight for the first time after edging Marta Kostyuk in a gruelling three-set battle.

Taylor Townsend steals the spotlight with bold all-black outfit at US Open Taylor Townsend made a bold fashion statement in a dramatic all-black outfit before her US Open Round of 16 clash against Aryna Sabalenka. Her impressive run at Flushing Meadows, however, ended with a 6-4, 6-3 defeat against the world No.1.

Italian GP: Kimi Antonelli ends six-decade wait for an Italian winner at Monza Kimi Antonelli produced a stunning comeback to win the Italian Grand Prix on Sunday, charging from 19th on the grid to take victory at Monza. The Mercedes driver became the first Italian to win at the iconic circuit since Ludovico Scarfiotti in 1966.

Premier League: Arsenal pass Chelsea test, show character in 2-1 comeback win Arsenal fought back to beat Chelsea 2-1 in a thrilling first heavyweight clash of the new Premier League campaign, with both sides producing an early contender for game of the season.

Aryna Sabalenka hammers Taylor Townsend, emulates Serena with quarters berth Aryna Sabalenka beat Taylor Townsend 6-4, 6-3 to reach her sixth consecutive US Open quarterfinal, matching Serena Williams' feat from 2011-2016. The world No. 1 extended her US Open winning streak to 17 matches and moved one step closer to a third straight title in New York.

Will India Women get Asia Cup trophy if they win? Naqvi to attend closing ceremony Mohsin Naqvi is expected to attend the Women's T20 Asia Cup final in Dubai, potentially setting up another awkward trophy presentation involving India.India Women have reached the semi-finals unbeaten after dominant wins over Thailand, Hong Kong and Pakistan.

India blank Bangladesh 3-0, seal AFC U20 Asian Cup qualification after 20 years India ended their 20-year wait to return to the AFC U20 Asian Cup after the Blue Colts beat Bangladesh 3-0 in their final Group B qualifier at the Do'stlik Stadium in Tashkent on Sunday.

Haters gonna hate: Austrian tennis star responds to Amanda Anisimova 'bye' backlash Anastasia Potapova has dismissed criticism over her post-match 'bye' wave after beating Amanda Anisimova, saying she was waving to a friend in the stands. The Austrian advanced to the US Open fourth round, where she will face fifth seed Mirra Andreeva.

Late Maitland-Niles wondergoal rescues Everton in 2-2 draw with Manchester UnitedAinsley Maitland-Niles scored a stoppage-time equaliser on his Everton debut to earn his side a 2-2 draw with Manchester United in the Premier League at the Hill Dickinson Stadium on Sunday.

Pakistan Super League may move to January 2027 to avoid clash with IPLThe Pakistan Super League could move into a new window next year, with January-February emerging as a possible slot after the tournament's media rights holder raised concerns over weak advertising and sponsorship revenues during its April-May clash with the Indian Premier League.

Anjum Chopra draws criticism for questioning Smriti Mandhana after Pakistan clashAnjum Chopra's criticism of Smriti Mandhana after India's win over Pakistan has drawn backlash, with fans defending the opener after her early dismissal. Mandhana scored nine runs as India beat their arch-rivals by seven wickets in Dubai on Saturday.

Big boost from China Masters win will fuel Asian Games charge: Satwik, ChiragSatwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty said staying "mindfully aggressive" helped them break their China Masters jinx, with the title providing a timely boost ahead of their Asian Games title defence.

Ex-Pak captain traces Pakistan's cricket crisis to historic 10-wicket win vs IndiaMohammad Yousuf has pointed to a rather unexpected moment when he believes Pakistan cricket started going downhill: their 10-wicket win over India at the 2021 T20 World Cup.

Iva Jovic fights back tears after Alex Eala turns heartbreak into touching momentAlexandra Eala's US Open campaign ended in a bruising three-set defeat to close friend Iva Jovic, but her touching post-match gesture stole the spotlight. Eala embraced Jovic at the net and wished her well, leaving the American visibly emotional after an intense battle between two close friends.

Yastika Bhatia impresses on Women's CPL debut, Shikha Pandey wrecks Barbados TridentsYastika Bhatia impressed on her WCPL debut with a composed 35, while Shikha Pandey starred with three wickets as Trinbago Knight Riders beat Barbados Tridents by 21 runs. Pooja Vastrakar endured a disappointing outing with both bat and ball.

Duleep Trophy final: Ishan Kishan hundred caps East Zone's dominant Day 1Ishan Kishan's unbeaten 111 powered East Zone to 385/4 against South Zone on Day 1 of the Duleep Trophy final in Chennai. With Kumar Kushagra also unbeaten on 63, East Zone ended the day firmly in control after South Zone's bowlers struggled to contain the batters.

Ajit Agarkar attends Duleep Trophy final days after missing key BCCI review meetingChairman of selectors Ajit Agarkar was in the stands at the MA Chidambaram Stadium in Chennai on Sunday as South Zone took on East Zone in the Duleep Trophy final. His presence came three days after he missed the BCCI review meeting in Mumbai, which had sparked speculation about his absence.

Satwik-Chirag break China Masters jinx, beat Hi-Ren to win maiden titleStar Indian men's doubles pair Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty produced a stirring comeback to beat China's He Ji Ting and Ren Xiang Yu in a three-game thriller and clinch the China Masters Super 750 title here on Sunday.

Boccia through the eyes of Sachin Chamaria: Inside India's hidden Paralympic gemIndia has a hidden gem in para sports in the form of boccia. Derived from the same sport as lawn bowls, Sachin Chamaria takes us through the rules of a sport that could provide India with a new pathway to success at the Paralympics.

Kya re vice captain: Rattled Tilak Varma sledges Vaibhav in Duleep Trophy finalSouth Zone captain Tilak Varma was left rattled in the Duleep Trophy final on Sunday, September 6. Facing an incredible onslaught from Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Abhimanyu Easwaran, Tilak resorted to sledging the teenager in the first hour of play.

Sooryavanshi for Test cricket? Teenager tears into Siraj in Duleep Trophy finalVaibhav Sooryavanshi tore into South Zone bowlers on Day 1 of the Duleep Trophy Final. Sooryavanshi took Mohammed Siraj to the cleaners to hand East Zone a sizeable advantage in the morning session.

Day 8 schedule: Sabalenka, Alcaraz headline fourth-round actionAryna Sabalenka and Carlos Alcaraz lead the US Open Day 8 fourth-round schedule in New York. Quarter-final spots are on the line alongside several key American match-ups.

Alexander Zverev overcomes Tabilo wobble to reach fourth roundAlexander Zverev beat Alejandro Tabilo in straight sets to reach the US Open fourth round. He recovered from a second-set wobble and set up a last-16 meeting with Luciano Darderi.

Who will retire Rohit Sharma?Rohit Sharma's retirement has been announced, discussed and speculated about several times, but the 39-year-old keeps scoring runs. So, who gets to decide when India's former captain's career is finally over?

Infantino dodges FIFA future questions amid fallout over failed World Cup planGianni Infantino declined to discuss his future at FIFA when asked at the Under-20 Women's World Cup in Poland. His silence comes as scrutiny persists over FIFA's failed plan to sell a share of future World Cup profits.

Pakistan still the best: Coach's bizarre take after India bundles them out for 55Women's Asia Cup: Pakistan were bowled out for 55 before India raced to victory in just 8.4 overs. Yet coach Wahab Riaz insisted his side remained the best team in the Women's Asia Cup, a claim that raised eyebrows.

Lionel Messi starts life after Argentina with two assists in Inter Miami drawLionel Messi returned to club action after announcing his Argentina retirement and set up both Inter Miami goals. The 39-year-old influenced the contest despite Miami conceding a late penalty to draw 2-2.

Forest fires surge tenfold from 2004 to 2017: Causes, impact and preventionAmidst a relentless surge, intense forest fires are now multiplying tenfold, casting a menacing shadow over our flora and fauna. Fresh plea in Supreme Court to recall NEET results, reconduct examsA fresh petition has been filed in the Supreme Court to recall the National Entrance cum Eligibility Test - Under Graduate (NEET-UG) 2024 results and re-conduct fresh examination after discrepancies in the declared results.

Exclusive: Arvind Kejriwal claims 'BJP succession war, PM backing Amit Shah'Speaking exclusively to India Today TV, Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal claimed that there is a "succession war" within the BJP. 4 medical students arrested in Bihar for appearing as proxies for NEET aspirantsFour MBBS students who appeared in place of NEET aspirants in the medical entrance exam were detained in Bihar's Purnea.

NEET-UG question paper not leaked, claims baseless: National Testing AgencyThe reports claiming question paper leak in the medical entrance exam NEET-UG are "completely baseless and without any ground", the National Testing Agency (NTA) has clarified.

Left sweeps JNU students' polls, Dhananjay is first Dalit presidentThe Left swept the Jawaharlal Nehru University Students' Union (JNUSU) polls, winning all four posts and trouncing the RSS-affiliated ABVP. JNU students' body election on March 22 after 4 yearsThe Jawaharlal Nehru University Students' Union (JNUSU) polls will take place on March 22, more than four years after the last elections were held in September 2019.

UP 12th board exam math, biology papers leaked on WhatsApp, complaint filedThe mathematics and biology question papers for the Uttar Pradesh class 12 board exam were allegedly leaked on a WhatsApp group.
